mapper.select: /* MultiWgMapper.selectSubMultiWgList : Multi 멀티중량 sub List */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SEQ_NO_ID ASC) AS NUM ,multi.OD_JOB_NO ,multi.SEQ_NO_ID ,multi.DELIVERY_NO ,multi.DELIVERY_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_DELIVERY_CODE' AND CODE = multi.DELIVERY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_NAME ,multi.CUSTOMER_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = multi.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_NAME ,multi.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED ,multi.PIECES ,multi.PAYMENT_GUBN ,multi.DELIVERY_FEE ,multi.DIM_WIDTH ,multi.DIM_LENGTH ,multi.DIM_HEIGHT ,multi.VWT ,multi.REMARKS ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = multi.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,multi.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,multi.RECIPIENT_NAME AS RECIPIENT_USER_NAME ,multi.RECEIPT_DATE ,od.HBL_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI multi ON od.OD_JOB_NO = multi.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ORDER BY multi.SEQ_NO_ID

/* MultiWgMapper.selectOrder : 오더 상세조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.DELIVERY_NAME ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1_NAME ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,od.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME ,od.UPDATE_DATE_TIME FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
